data.one_liner: Flutter widget for embedding YouTube videos via the official iFrame API
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebView‑based player that supports inline playback, custom controls, playlists, lazy thumbnails, and full‑screen handling across Android, iOS, macOS and Web.
use_when: Embedding YouTube videos in a Flutter app
Need full control over playback UI
Want lazy thumbnail loading for lists
Require cross‑platform support without API key
avoid_when: You need a native player for non‑YouTube videos
You need advanced analytics or DRM support
You want to avoid WebView overhead on low‑memory devices
strengths: Full control over UI via YoutubeValueBuilder
Lazy thumbnail support for efficient lists
Automatic full‑screen handling and rotation support
weaknesses: Relies on WebView, which can be heavy
No native media controls outside YouTube
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, follow webview_flutter setup guide for each platform (Android, iOS, macOS, Web). No build_runner or codegen needed.

alternatives.name: youtube_player_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a ready‑made player with built‑in controls, but less customizable than youtube_player_iframe
